systems.system: Integrated Health Management Information System (iHMIS), also called the integrated Hospital Management Information System and the IICS system
systems.platform: Built by Integrated Intelligent Computer Systems (IICS) Technologies Ltd, a local firm
systems.owner: Ministry of ICT and National Guidance as contracting and funding ministry
systems.tiers: Deployed in selected health centres across the country (FY2021/22)

systems.owner: Innovator awardee under the National ICT Initiatives Support Programme
Innovator awardee under the National ICT Initiatives Support Programme

note: The ICT ministry's Q4 FY2021/22 report (excerpt, cut off at page 35 of 91) records contracting IICS Technologies Ltd to develop the iHMIS, an inception report approved for a 20% payment, deployment in selected health centres and UGX 5.01bn spent from the domestic budget under grants to innovators; it never says what the system does or that it holds a clinical record, so it cannot be classed and gives no fact.
